$comment: One entry per method: its body, or one body per request op (`selected_by`). `encoding` is the ResultPayload variant; a `Raw` body is a MessagePack `bin` holding the MessagePack encoding of `schema`, a `Json` body is that value as a JSON tree. A body with a `dynamic` reason is chosen by the caller and has the unconstrained schema `true`.

AdamResult.description: One Adam step: the updated parameters and moment estimates.

crit_1pct.description: Finite-sample-interpolated MacKinnon critical values (constant, no trend).

p_value_approx.description: Approximate p-value (monotone interpolation across the critical points).

Algorithm.description: The solver algorithm that produced a certificate.

oneOf.description:
Propagation, greedy incumbent, depth-first branch-and-bound with a
dual-ascent Lagrangian bound, pre-order leaf-bound certificate.

BoundProof.description: The lower-bound evidence a certificate carries.

oneOf.description: Only the root dual (the tree exceeded the certificate leaf limit).

Certificate.description: Everything a verifier needs, and nothing it must trust.

lower_bound.description: Certified scalar lower bound, when any bound leaf exists.

ClassifierFitResult.description: `MineClassifyFit`: the fitted classifier, passed back to `MineClassifyPredict`.

ClusterExpansion.description:
`ClusterHierarchyExpand`: a level-1 cluster expands to its member nodes and edges
(`child_clusters` empty); a coarser cluster expands to its children one level
finer (`nodes` and `edges` empty).

ClusterHierarchySummary.description: `ClusterHierarchyRefresh`: what was computed and whether it was cached durably.

cached.description: `false` when the backend has no persistence to cache the hierarchy in.

levels.description: Number of computed levels (level 1 is the finest).

top_level_clusters.description: Cluster count of the coarsest level; 0 when no level was computed.

ClusterLevelView.description: `ClusterHierarchyClusters`: one level of the cached hierarchy.

ClusterMemberEdge.description: An edge between two member nodes of a level-1 cluster.

type.description: The edge's `relationship` property, or `"_"` when it has none.

ClusterMemberNode.description: A member node of a level-1 cluster, read live off the graph.

properties.description: The node's stored properties, decoded; `null` when undecodable.

responsibilities.description: Per-row soft assignments; present only for a mixture model.

ClusterRow.description: One cluster; `cluster_id` is negative for a noise bucket.

ClusterSummary.description: One cluster as served to a visualization client.

top_node_types.description: Up to 5 most common node types among the members, descending.

deadline_hit.description:
`true` when the budget expired before convergence: the partition is the
best found so far, and a writeback has already persisted it.

modularity.description: `null` for an algorithm that does not optimize modularity.

ConvergenceGate.description: Conviction gate over N signal strengths.

CrossEntropyResult.description: Mean categorical cross-entropy and its gradient w.r.t. the logits.

grad.description: dL/dlogits, shape == logits (softmax - one_hot, averaged over the batch).

DieboldMariano.description: Diebold-Mariano test of equal predictive accuracy.

DirectlyFollowsRow.description: A directly-follows edge between two activities.

DistResult.description:
The result of a distributed computation, in a wire-ready form. Serialized to
`ResultPayload::Raw` by the handler.

oneOf.description: PageRank: `(id, score)` rows, sorted by id (deterministic).

Connected components: `(id, component_repr_index)` rows, sorted by id. The
component label is the index of the component's representative in the sorted
vertex list (a stable small int), so it round-trips losslessly.

DpoResult.description: Bradley-Terry DPO loss and its gradients w.r.t. the chosen/rejected log-probs.

FittedClassifier.description:
Serializable fitted classifier returned by `mining::classify::fit` and consumed
back by `mining::classify::predict` (the PREDICTIVE fit→blob→predict pair). Lives
in eg-types so `Method::MineClassifyPredict` can embed the model over the wire —
exactly like `FittedModel` carries the datascience regressors. `classes` is the
sorted set of integer labels; every score/proba vector is column-ordered by it.

oneOf.description: Gaussian Naive Bayes — per-class prior + per-feature (mean, variance).
Multinomial Naive Bayes — per-class log-prior + Laplace-smoothed feature log-probs.
k-NN — the lazy classifier stores its training rows + labels for the vote.

One-vs-rest linear classifier (`kind` = `logistic` | `svc`): a weight vector +
bias per class. Prediction is argmax of the per-class score.

trend.description: STL decomposition components; present only for the `stl` algorithm.

ForensicReport.description: Forensic-accounting scores for one fiscal year against the prior one.

flags.description: Human-readable flags that crossed a threshold.

GraphlearnPrediction.description: The top missing links scored by a `graphlearn`-family model.

GrpoResult.description: PPO/GRPO clipped surrogate loss and its gradient w.r.t. `logprob`.

Incumbent.description: A feasible assignment and its objective value.

InterClusterEdge.description:
An edge between two clusters of one served level, by array-local index into
that response's `clusters`.

KalmanState.description: Filtered states and variances of a scalar Kalman filter.

LagrangeDual.description: Row multipliers `numerator / denominator`, entries strictly ordered by row.

LeafProof.description: How a leaf of the search tree is closed.

oneOf.description: `L(dual, path)` is a lower bound on every feasible completion.
`L(dual, path)` with a zero objective is positive: no feasible completion.

LevelValue.description: Value of one objective level under an assignment.

known.description: Sum of the known coefficients of the selected variables.

unknown_selected.description: How many selected variables have an unknown coefficient at this level.

LinkPrediction.description: `GraphLearnPredict`: scored links and the model digest that scored them.

LinkPredictorFit.description: `GraphLearnFit`: the fitted model and a summary of what it learned.

model.description:
The fitted model, passed back verbatim to `GraphLearnPredict`. Opaque on the
wire (the request carries it as JSON too), so no KAN type leaks here.

MergeProposal.description:
One proposed entity-resolution action returned by `ResolveCandidates`.

The compute implementation owns the algorithm and therefore cannot be a
dependency of this bottom-of-DAG crate. This wire mirror keeps the result
contract typed while preserving the implementation's four serialized fields.

MotifMiningResult.description: Motif counting over the host graph; never writes back.

ObjectiveValue.description: Every level's value plus the exact scalarised objective.

OntologyMatch.description:
One capability term found in a query by the ontology lexical gate
(CONCEPT:EG-ORCH.routing.lexical-capability-escalation). `term` is the matched alias/name, `node_type` its capability
class (Tool/Skill/MCPServer/…), `label` the owning node's display name,
`mcp_server` the owning fleet server (so a caller can bind that server's
toolset directly), and `score` the matched term's character length.

PatternEdge.description: A labeled edge of a frequent subgraph pattern, by pattern-local node index.

PipelineComparison.description: `MiningPipelineCompare`: two versions' recorded metrics and their numeric diff.

diff.description:
`b - a` for every numeric primary metric both versions share; `null` when
either version has no metric object.

PipelineEvaluation.description: `MiningPipelineEvaluate`: metrics of a served tabular model on caller data.

metrics.description: The family's metric object (accuracy/F1 for classify, R²/RMSE for estimator).

PipelinePrediction.description:
`MiningPipelinePredict`: the body is selected by the served model's family,
published as the `family` field.

PipelineTrainResult.description: `MiningPipelineTrain`: the trained version and its held-out metrics.

classes.description: The label classes of a classifier; `null` for other families.

metrics.description: Per-split metric objects; their keys depend on the model family.

version.description: The assigned version; 0 when not written back.

ProofNode.description: One pre-order node of the search-tree proof.

QueueSignal.description: Queue-imbalance skew and per-side fill times.

withdraw.description: True when an inventory / boundary cap says "withdraw, do not quote".

singular_values.description: Present only for an algorithm that produces singular values.

RegimeResult.description: A fitted Gaussian HMM regime model.

n_iterations.description: Number of EM iterations until convergence

RetrievalQualityMiningResult.description: `MineRetrievalQuality`: aggregate retrieval metrics over the traces.

RiskMetrics.description: Summary risk metrics of a return series.

best.description: The top candidate; `null` when there is none.

RowId.description:
Index of a constraint (its position in [`ModelSpec::constraints`]). Every
constraint lowers to exactly one linear row, so this is also the row index.

RowRef.description:
A row of a vector-mining input: its node id when the rows came from a node
source, else its index in the explicit input matrix.

SabrFit.description: A SABR smile calibration with `beta` fixed.

Scalar.description: An exact 128-bit signed integer (objective values, bounds, multipliers).

Sha256Digest.description: A SHA-256 digest, serialised as 64 lower-case hex characters.

SolveResult.description: A solved model: the certificate plus the digest a caller pins it by.

SolveStatus.description: The outcome class of a solve.

oneOf.description: The incumbent is optimal and the tree or root proof certifies it.

The search completed; its tree exceeded the certificate limit, so the
proof is a reproducible deterministic derivation, not a certificate.
The budget ran out with a certified gap no larger than the accepted gap.
No feasible assignment exists; `core` lists the rows the proof uses.

The search completed without a feasible assignment and without a
certificate-sized tree.
The budget ran out with no incumbent or a gap above the accepted gap.

SolverConfig.description: Deterministic work limits and gap acceptance. No wall clock is read.

SpreadReversion.description: Rolling spread z-score and its mean-reversion signal.

SubgraphMiningResult.description: `MineSubgraph`: the body is selected by the request's algorithm.

nodes.description: Node labels, indexed by pattern-local node index.

SurveillanceRisk.description: Continuous-time-Kyle surveillance estimate over a trailing book/flow window.

algorithm.description: Absent when there were no documents to mine.

TrainTestSplitResult.description: The four partitions of a train/test split.

TreeNode.description: A flat regression tree: node `i` is a leaf when `feature < 0`.

VarId.description: Index of a binary decision variable (its position in [`ModelSpec::variables`]).

Vf2MatchResult.description:
Materialized result of a bounded VF2 subgraph-isomorphism search.

`truncated` is true when either the requested match limit or search-step
budget stopped the search before the candidate space was exhausted.

dynamic.summary: opaque bytes the caller wrote or a caller-supplied program produced
